hero.subhead: At Grupo ZER we design, develop, and operate digital solutions that transform the way people and businesses solve their everyday needs.

pillars.title: Three principles that guide every decision.
pillars.lede: Innovation, agility, and service. Not decorative words — they are the filters through which we design, build, and operate every product in the group.

p1.title: Innovation
p1.body: We apply purposeful technology, building products that intelligently solve real-world problems.

p2.title: Agility
p2.body: We move fast. We iterate, learn, and ship solutions that evolve at the pace of our users.

p3.title: Service
p3.body: The user is at the center of everything we do. Reliability and closeness are part of our promise.

about.title: A Dominican family-owned company, with technological purpose.
about.body: Grupo ZER is a Dominican company founded with the purpose of bringing high-value technology-driven products and services to the local market. We create, develop, and deploy digital solutions —both web and mobile— for enterprises and individual consumers, with a focus on simplicity, reliability, and security.

story.title: Three initials. One family vision.
story.body1: Grupo ZER is a Dominican family-owned company founded by two professionals with over a decade of combined experience in the banking and technology sectors. After years searching for a business idea that would combine purpose, innovation, and real impact on people's lives, the company was born with the goal of bringing technology solutions to the local market, simplifying everyday processes through digital products and services.
story.body2: The name ZER comes from the initials of the founders' three daughters — Zoe, Emma, and Renata — and encapsulates the vision of building a family of brands, products, and services designed to create value in everyday life. Each solution within the group is conceived as an extension of this promise: useful, reliable, and approachable technology.

mvv.missionBody: To design, develop, and deploy digital solutions that simplify the everyday lives of people and businesses, upheld by standards of reliability, security, and closeness.
mvv.visionBody: To become the leading Dominican technology group in the creation of digital brands and products that transform everyday habits and generate sustainable value in the market.

v5.b: The foundation of everything we do.

leaders.title: The founders.
leaders.l1: Business Administrator with extensive experience in the Dominican banking sector. Leads strategy, operations, and commercial development at Grupo ZER.
leaders.l2: Systems Engineer with deep expertise in the financial technology sector. Leads product, engineering, and technology strategy at Grupo ZER.

purpose.body: Grupo ZER is dedicated to the creation, development, implementation, commercialization, and support of digital service solutions, as well as to the development of web and mobile applications for both businesses and individuals.

portfolio.title: Independent brands. One promise.
portfolio.body: At Grupo ZER we build independent brands, each designed to address a specific need through applied technology. Our portfolio grows deliberately, adding solutions that meet our standards of innovation, agility, and service.
